title: GCD: GCM-consistent Diffusion for Zero-shot Downscaling across Heterogeneous GCMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.21760v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Climate downscaling of General Circulation Models (GCMs) is an ill-posed inverse problem, as GCM outputs and reanalysis fields arise from different dynamical systems and lack fine-scale temporal pairing. Supervised methods thus rely on synthetic degradations or model-specific adaptation, limiting generalization across heterogeneous GCMs. Zero-shot diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) avoids paired supervision by combining a high-resolution climate prior with inference-time constraints from coarse GCM inputs, but faces consistency and efficiency challenges. We propose GCM-consistent Diffusion for Zero-shot Downscaling (GCD), which addresses these challenges with geographic conditioning, spectrally filtered measurement guidance, and distillation-accelerated Conjugate Gradient guidance. translated_title: GCD：面向异构GCM零样本降尺度的一致性扩散模型
translated_abstract: 大气环流模型（GCM）的气候降尺度是一个不适定的逆问题，因为GCM输出与再分析场来自不同的动力系统，且缺乏精细尺度上的时间配对数据。因此，监督式方法依赖于合成退化或针对特定模型的适配，限制了其在异构GCM之间的泛化能力。零样本扩散后验采样（DPS）通过将高分辨率气候先验与来自粗分辨率GCM输入的推理时约束相结合，避免了配对监督的需求，但面临一致性和效率方面的挑战。我们提出了GCM一致性零样本降尺度扩散模型（GCD），通过地理条件化、频谱滤波的测量引导以及蒸馏加速的共轭梯度引导来解决这些挑战。GCD将推理过程从1,000步扩散减少到6步，同时保持与粗分辨率GCM输入的一致性。在五个异构GCM上，GCD取得了（摘要内容在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出GCD方法，通过地理条件化、频谱滤波测量引导和蒸馏加速的共轭梯度引导，实现了跨异构GCM的零样本气候降尺度，并将扩散推理步数从1,000步降至6步，兼顾了一致性与效率。
en_tdlr: GCD is a zero-shot diffusion downscaling framework that leverages geographic conditioning, spectrally filtered measurement guidance, and distillation-accelerated conjugate gradient guidance to achieve GCM-consistent climate downscaling across heterogeneous GCMs while reducing inference from 1,000 to 6 diffusion steps.
